defs.def: a country considered as a group of people with the same language, culture and history, who live in a particular area under one government 国家；民族

ex.s: The call for public engagement with the unthinkable is especially germane in this moment of still-uncontrolled pandemic and economic crises in the world's most technologically advanced nations.
ex.t: 公众参与讨论不可想象之事的呼吁在当今世界最发达的国家仍处于失控的大流行病和经济危机这一时刻尤其相关。

ex.s: Not very long ago, it was also unthinkable that a virus would shut down nations and that safety nets would be proven so disastrously lacking in flexibility.
ex.t: 就在不久前，一场病毒会让各国停摆、而社会保障网会被证明如此缺乏灵活性也同样是难以想象的。

ex.s: In 1993 the United Nations decided that March 22nd is the World Day for Water.
ex.t: 1993年，联合国决定将3月22日定为世界水日。

ex.s: the present state of our nation
Saint Augustine is the oldest city in the nation.
ex.t: 圣奥古斯丁是该国最古老的城市。

ex.s: Others say it’s only natural that newcomers learn the language of their host nation, seeing it as a condition to ensure they can contribute to society.
ex.t: 另一些人说，新来者学习所在国的语言是再自然不过的事，他们把这看作是为了确保自己能为社会做贡献的一个条件。

ex.s: Furthermore, around 50% of the world’s population live in regions where the figure is now below the replacement level (ie 2.1 births per woman) and almost all developed nations are experiencing sub-replacement birth rate.
ex.t: 此外，约50%的世界人口生活在生育率目前低于替代水平（即每名女性2.1个孩子）的地区，几乎所有发达国家都在经历低于替代水平的生育率。

ex.s: As for the USA, it is almost unique among developed nations in having a population that is expected to grow by 20% from 2010—2030.
ex.t: 至于美国，在发达国家中它几乎独一无二，其人口预计在2010至2030年间增长20%。

ex.s: When vaccination rates are very high, as they still are in the nation as a whole, everyone is protected.
ex.t: 当接种率非常高时——全国整体目前仍然如此——每个人都会受到保护。

ex.s: Every nation has its own festivals celebrating different things.
ex.t: 每个国家都有自己的节日，庆祝不同的事情。

ex.s: The United Nations Children’s Fund, also knowing / known as UNICEF, is a United Nations (UN) organization basing / based in New York.
ex.t: 联合国儿童基金会，也称为UNICEF，是一个总部设在纽约的联合国组织。

ex.s: UNESCO - the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organisation - maintains a list of sites of outstanding natural importance, so as to protect, conserve and promote awareness of them.
ex.t: 联合国教科文组织——联合国教育、科学及文化组织——维护着一个具有突出自然重要性的地点名录，以保护、保存和提高人们对它们的认识。

ex.s: But this address to the crowd changed the minds of his people and helped shape a nation.
ex.t: 但这次对民众的演讲改变了人民的想法，并帮助塑造了一个国家。

ex.s: Four score and seven years ago our fathers brought forth, upon this continent, a new nation, conceived in Liberty, and dedicated to the proposition that all men are created equal.
ex.t: 四分七年前，我们的父亲在这个大陆上诞生了一个新的国家，这个国家是在自由中构想的，并致力于实现人人生而平等的主张。

ex.s: Understanding history is vital to understanding ourselves as a people and as a nation． History is much more than the study of dusty old objects and events long past． It is an essential part of who we are today and who we will become． Thornton Middle School History Fair Competition makes understanding history exciting， engaging， and fun!
ex.t: 理解历史对理解我们作为一个民族、一个国家的自我至关重要。历史远不止是对尘封旧物与久远事件的研究。它是我们今天之所是、未来之将是的本质部分。桑顿中学历史博览会竞赛让理解历史变得激动人心、引人入胜且充满乐趣！

ex.s: You might think that developing nations would make up the loss (especially since 80% of the world’s people now live in such nations), but you’d be wrong.
ex.t: 你可能以为发展中国家会弥补这一损失（特别是既然世界上80%的人现在生活在这样的国家），但你错了。

defs.def: all the people in a country 国民
